highlights: See agent photos, channel pictures and image previews of a joined server again in the desktop app.
Connect to your servers again within seconds after a Signal update, not after about 5 minutes.
Use Gemini agents with many apps connected: a turn that loaded OpenBot's tools slowly no longer shows as failed.
Send /compact to a Claude agent with no false "no answer" error.
Read web terminals in the agent browser, such as the Proxmox console, at normal text size again.
